description: Nkom collects data from all providers of electronic communications services in Norway and publishes them as raw data and in processed form. The annual ekom statistics for the full year 2025, published on 18 June 2026, can be downloaded by service as XLSX and CSV files: mobile services, fixed broadband, fixed telephony, data communication, TV services, transmission capacity, and a file with all data. As the responsible producer of official statistics on telephony, broadband and TV subscriptions, Nkom also publishes fixed broadband subscriptions nationally and regionally, broadband coverage for 2025 and mobile coverage for 2025 as XLSX files, and interactive Power BI dashboards and static reports on its statistics pages. Coverage: Norway, national and regional. Format and access: XLSX and CSV downloads and dashboards, free. Caveats: provider-reported figures; coverage mapping methods are described separately by Nkom and were not read; the ekomstatistikken web application did not answer automated requests. Simulation uses: subscriptions, traffic and transmission capacity for demand and backbone models, and coverage figures for exposure of Norwegian regions. Related records: the Nordic-Baltic telecom statistics compare Norway with its neighbours, and the Nkom reinforced mobile coverage programme and Finnsenderen give resilience measures and sites.
